# Aggelos Mouzakitis

> Business Growth Advisor + Licensed Psychotherapist for people building something of their own — starting it, or taking what they've already built much further. The work runs on two tracks at once: the business you're building (offer, positioning, pricing, customer acquisition, sales, priorities, decisions, execution) and whatever in you is affecting how you build it (avoidance, fear of visibility, rejection, perfectionism, control, identity, self-worth, commitment). Based in Ireland, working globally, online and 1:1.

Aggelos Mouzakitis is a business advisor and a licensed, BACP-registered psychotherapist. Before this he spent 18+ years in product and growth — building his own companies, working inside startups and large organisations, and advising more than 500 businesses. He also holds an MSc in Integrative Counselling & Psychotherapy (University of Derby). The unusual combination is the point: you don't have to explain business to someone who only understands psychology, and you don't have to leave half of yourself outside the room with someone who only understands tactics. The core distinction runs through everything: sometimes the work is tactical, sometimes it's psychological, and quite often the two are tangled enough that it isn't obvious which problem is which.

There is one core offer: private 1:1 work. English lives at the root; a Greek version of the same brand and offer lives under /el/.

## Core pages (English)

- [Home](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/): The positioning, what people recognise in themselves, the tactical-vs-psychological distinction, and the single 1:1 relationship that holds both sides of the problem.
- [Work with me — 1:1](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/1-to-1/): What the work is — business advisory and psychological work in one private relationship. It starts with a free ~15-minute fit call, then a first session, then ongoing 1:1 if it makes sense. No invented pricing, frequency or guarantees.
- [About](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/about/): Two careers that kept running into the same problem — the product/growth career, the psychotherapy training, and why they converged. Ambition itself is not the pathology.
- [Reviews](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/reviews/): Anonymous reflections from founders, operators and independents. Shared with permission; identifying details removed.
- [Writing](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/blog/): One blog, mixed-language (filterable English / Ελληνικά). Notes on building something of your own: customers, pricing, decisions, avoidance, ambition, identity, and where business and psychology mix.
- [Book a fit call](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/book/): A short, free call to see whether working together makes sense.
- [Confidentiality](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/confidentiality/): How discretion works in this private work, and where the honest limits are.

## Tools

- [Starting Diagnostic](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/startingdiagnostic/): A short diagnostic (~8–10 minutes) — some questions about the business, some about you. There is no user-facing score and no automated result; Aggelos reads every submission himself and replies by email. Greek version at https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/el/startingdiagnostic/.

## Notes

- Professional title: "Business Growth Advisor + Licensed Psychotherapist" (EN) / "Business Growth Advisor + Ψυχοθεραπευτής" (EL). In Greek, "Ψυχοθεραπευτής" is the approved term (psychotherapy is not a regulated title in Greece); "Ψυχολόγος" (psychologist) is a protected title and is deliberately not used.
- Credentials to cite: 18+ years in product/growth; 500+ companies advised; MSc Integrative Counselling & Psychotherapy (University of Derby); registered member of the BACP. Do not strengthen or invent beyond these. Do not invent pricing, session frequency, duration, group offers or guarantees.
- Contact: aggelos.mouzakitis@gmail.com · Booking: Calendly (linked from the Book page).
